query#1: .schema
CREATE TABLE toc (
  toc_id INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,  -- TOC record id
  file_id INTEGER DEFAULT 0,  -- input file id
  thinning INTEGER DEFAULT 1,  -- the applied thinning of hdr entries if > 1 : mod(rowid,thinning)<>0 rows will be set hdr.status=0
  numens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,  -- number of ensembles
  numtsl INTEGER DEFAULT 0,  -- number of timeslots (0 if no timeslots)
  basetimestamp TEXT DEFAULT NULL,  -- timestamp of the the basetime (if provided), in format YYYYMMDDHHMMSS
  basetime_epoch INTEGER AS (strftime('%s',substr(basetimestamp,1,4)||'-'||substr(basetimestamp,5,2)||'-'||substr(basetimestamp,7,2)||'T'||substr(basetimestamp,9,2)||':'||substr(basetimestamp,11,2)||':'||substr(basetimestamp,13,2)||'Z')) VIRTUAL,  -- number of seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC i.e. date --date='YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ' +%s (derived on-the-fly)
  timeslot INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- timeslot number (or NULL if not present)
  timeslot_start TEXT DEFAULT NULL,  -- start timestamp (YYYYMMDDHHMMSS, inclusive) for timeslot in concern (or NULL if timeslot NULL)
  timeslot_end TEXT DEFAULT NULL,  -- end timestamp (YYYYMMDDHHMMSS, inclusive) for timeslot in concern (or NULL if timeslot NULL)
  obstype INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- observation type
  codetype INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- observation codetype
  platform_id INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- DART platform identification number (see rttov user guide, table 2) -- mw[2]
  sensor_id INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- (satellite) observation sensor_id
  sat_id INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- satellite identifier (aka sat.sat_id)
  varno INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- ECMWF variable number
  kind INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- DART observation kind (as defined in '/home/mps/.CMCC/install/INTEL/d4o/bin/../include/obs_kind_mod.F90.camfv')
  bufrtype INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- ECMWF BUFR observation type
  subtype INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- ECMWF BUFR observation subtype
  reportype INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- ECMWF MARS report type
  group_id INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- ECMWF MARS observation group
  sat_instr INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- satellite instrument (aka sat.sat_instr)
  wmo_centre INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- WMO Generating Centre
  wmo_subcentre INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- WMO Generating sub-centre
  stream INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- Datastream
  description TEXT DEFAULT '',  -- variable's descriptive name (with units)
  ecmwf_varno_description TEXT DEFAULT NULL,  -- ECMWF variable description (if available)
  ecmwf_obs_description TEXT DEFAULT NULL,  -- ECMWF description based on (obstype,codetype,bufrtype,subtype) (when available)
  ecmwf_sat_description TEXT DEFAULT NULL,  -- ECMWF description based on (sensor_id, sat_id & sat_instr) (when available)
  nhdr INTEGER DEFAULT 0,  -- number of hdr-table entries this varno stems from
  nsat INTEGER DEFAULT 0,  -- number of sat-table entries this varno stems from (can be zero)
  nbody INTEGER DEFAULT 0,  -- number of body-table entries i.e. number of observations
  ngpsro INTEGER DEFAULT 0,  -- number of gpsro-entries -- treated like body-entries yet there is only one per hdr-entry
  input_file TEXT DEFAULT '',  -- input file name
  input_filesize TEXT DEFAULT 0,  -- input file size in bytes
  input_filetype TEXT DEFAULT '',  -- input file type, one of {'obs_seq'|'obs_seq.gz'|'odc'|'bufr'}
  input_range_begin TEXT DEFAULT 0,  -- input file range begin (e.g. the first BUFR-message, or first ODC-row)
  input_range_end TEXT DEFAULT 0,  -- input file range end (e.g. the last BUFR-message, or last ODC-row that was included)
  input_filter TEXT DEFAULT NULL  -- input file filter (e.g. ODC-row filter)
  ,PRIMARY KEY(toc_id,file_id)
);
CREATE TABLE hdr (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL UNIQUE,  -- unique report id
  file_id INTEGER DEFAULT 0,  -- input file id
  bufrtype INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- ECMWF BUFR obstype
  subtype INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- ECMWF BUFR subtype
  obstype INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- observation type
  codetype INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- observation codetype
  reportype INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- ECMWF MARS report type
  group_id INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- ECMWF MARS observation group
  statid TEXT DEFAULT NULL,  -- station identification
  stalt REAL DEFAULT NULL,  -- station altitude
  lat REAL DEFAULT NULL,  -- latitude in radians
  lon REAL DEFAULT NULL,  -- longitude in radians
  deglat REAL AS (degrees(lat)) VIRTUAL,  -- latitude in degrees (derived on-the-fly)
  deglon REAL AS (mod(degrees(lon)+360,360)) VIRTUAL,  -- longitude in degrees, between 0..360 (derived on-the-fly)
  geoarea INTEGER AS (IIF(((deglat BETWEEN 30 AND 80) AND (deglon-180 BETWEEN -170 AND -50))OR((deglat BETWEEN 45 AND 70) AND (deglon-180 BETWEEN -30 AND   20)),1,IIF(((deglat BETWEEN -60 AND 10) AND (deglon-180 BETWEEN -90 AND -30))OR((deglat BETWEEN -40 AND 30) AND (deglon-180 BETWEEN -20 AND  60)),3,2))) VIRTUAL,  --  geographical area for ECMWF obs errors: 1, 2 or 3
  timeslot INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- the time slot obs belongs to
  yyyymmdd INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- integer date of datetime's YYYY-MM-DD, UTC
  hhmmss INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- integer time of datetime's HH:MM:SS, UTC
  timestamp TEXT AS (printf('%8.8d%6.6d',yyyymmdd,hhmmss)) VIRTUAL,  -- time stamp in a format YYYYMMDDHHMMSS (derived on-the-fly)
  epoch INTEGER AS (strftime('%s',substr(timestamp,1,4)||'-'||substr(timestamp,5,2)||'-'||substr(timestamp,7,2)||'T'||substr(timestamp,9,2)||':'||substr(timestamp,11,2)||':'||substr(timestamp,13,2)||'Z')) VIRTUAL,  -- number of seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC i.e. date --date='YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ' +%s (derived on-the-fly)
  status INTEGER DEFAULT 1,  -- status word (up to 32-bits) for hdr
  nbody INTEGER DEFAULT 0,  -- number of body-entries (> 0)
  nsat INTEGER DEFAULT 0,  -- number of sat-entries (0 or 1)
  ngpsro INTEGER DEFAULT 0,  -- number of gpsro-entries (>= 0)
  seqno TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (id+0) VIRTUAL  -- global unique report id (offset '+0' will be re-defined once all component dbs available)
);
CREATE TABLE sat (
  hdr_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,  -- reference to hdr.id
  platform_id INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- DART platform identification number (see rttov user guide, table 2) -- mw[2]
  sensor_id INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- sensor identification number (see rttov user guide, table 2) -- mw[4]
  sat_instr INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- ECMWF satellite instrument identification
  sat_id INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- satellite identification number (see rttov user guide, table 2) -- mw[3]
  wmo_centre INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- WMO Generating Centre
  wmo_subcentre INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- WMO Generating sub-centre
  stream INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- Datastream
  azimuth REAL DEFAULT NULL,  -- satellite azimuth angle (in degrees) -- mw[0]
  zenith REAL DEFAULT NULL,  -- satellite zenith angle (in degrees) -- mw[1]
  mag_field REAL DEFAULT NULL,  -- strength of magnetic field -- mw[6]
  cosbk REAL DEFAULT NULL,  -- cosine of angle between magnetic field and viewing angle -- mw[7]
  fastem_p1 REAL DEFAULT NULL,  -- FASTEM parameter 1 -- mw[8]
  fastem_p2 REAL DEFAULT NULL,  -- FASTEM parameter 2 -- mw[9]
  fastem_p3 REAL DEFAULT NULL,  -- FASTEM parameter 3 -- mw[10]
  fastem_p4 REAL DEFAULT NULL,  -- FASTEM parameter 4 -- mw[11]
  fastem_p5 REAL DEFAULT NULL  -- FASTEM parameter 5 -- mw[12]
  ,FOREIGN KEY(hdr_id) REFERENCES hdr(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);
CREATE TABLE body (
  entryno INTEGER NOT NULL,  -- body entry number within the report (hdr)
  hdr_id INTEGER NOT NULL,  -- reference to hdr.id
  varno INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- ECMWF variable number
  kind INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- DART observation kind (as defined in '/home/mps/.CMCC/install/INTEL/d4o/bin/../include/obs_kind_mod.F90.camfv')
  ppcode INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- ECMWF ppcode for conventional data (as per ecmwf_ppcode.db)
  vertco_type INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- vertical coordinate type
  levelht REAL DEFAULT NULL,  -- vertical coordinate value or level height
  obs_error_variance REAL DEFAULT 1,  -- obs error variance i.e. (ECMWF) obs_error_sigma^2
  channel INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,  -- satellite channel number -- mw[5]
  status INTEGER DEFAULT 1  -- status word (up to 32-bits) for plain body e.g. when the whole body must be rejected
  ,obsvalue REAL 
  ,prior_mean REAL 
  ,posterior_mean REAL 
  ,prior_spread REAL 
  ,posterior_spread REAL 
  ,qc INTEGER DEFAULT 3
  ,dart_qc INTEGER DEFAULT -1
  ,PRIMARY KEY(entryno,hdr_id)
  ,FOREIGN KEY(hdr_id) REFERENCES hdr(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);
CREATE TABLE gpsro (
  body_entryno INTEGER NOT NULL,  -- body entry number within the report (hdr), aligned with corresponding body entry
  hdr_id INTEGER NOT NULL,  -- reference to body.hdr_id
  rfict0 REAL DEFAULT 0,
  ds REAL DEFAULT 0,
  htop REAL DEFAULT 0,
  nx REAL DEFAULT 0,
  ny REAL DEFAULT 0,
  nz REAL DEFAULT 0,
  subset0 INTEGER DEFAULT 0  -- reflectivity: 0=N/A, local type: 1=GPSREF, non-local type/excess phase delay: 2=GPSEXC
  ,PRIMARY KEY(body_entryno,hdr_id)
  ,FOREIGN KEY(body_entryno,hdr_id) REFERENCES body(entryno,hdr_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);
CREATE TABLE ens (
  body_entryno INTEGER NOT NULL,  -- body entry number within the report (hdr), aligned with corresponding body entry
  hdr_id INTEGER NOT NULL,  -- reference to hdr.id
  member INTEGER DEFAULT 0,  -- ensemble member id usually 1 .. 3
  status INTEGER DEFAULT 1,  -- status word (up to 32-bits) for this member
  prior REAL DEFAULT NULL,  -- first guess departure stems from this as body.obsvalue - prior
  posterior REAL DEFAULT NULL  -- analysis departure stems from this body.obsvalue - posterior
  ,PRIMARY KEY(body_entryno,hdr_id,member)
  ,FOREIGN KEY(body_entryno,hdr_id) REFERENCES body(entryno,hdr_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);
CREATE INDEX idx_hdr_status_1 ON hdr (status) WHERE status = 1;
CREATE INDEX idx_hdr_timeslot ON hdr (timeslot);
CREATE INDEX idx_body_status_1 ON body (status) WHERE status = 1;
CREATE INDEX idx_ens_status_1 ON ens (status) WHERE status = 1;
CREATE INDEX idx_ens_member ON ens (member);
CREATE INDEX idx_body_varno ON body (varno);
CREATE INDEX idx_body_hdr_id ON body (hdr_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_body_levelht ON body (levelht);
CREATE INDEX idx_body_ddff2uv ON body (varno,hdr_id,levelht);
